name: Bad Quiz: Horror!
source:
A masked murderer has kidnapped you. His goal: to force you to play his televised, life-or-death, horror-themed quiz show.

[From [url=https://team-four-star.itch.io/bad-quiz-horror]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名蒙面殺人犯綁架了你。他的目的是強迫你參加他那檔在電視上播出、拿生死當賭注的恐怖主題問答節目。

［摘自[url=https://team-four-star.itch.io/bad-quiz-horror]Itch.io[/url]］
